title: What GOTCHA is allowed to do
description: Three settings for everything: do it, ask me first, never. This applies to every AI employee.
unavailable: We couldn't read what GOTCHA is allowed to do just now.
noneBody: It can read and reply, but it cannot do anything to an order, a customer record or a calendar.
summary: {alone, plural, =0 {Nothing here happens without you approving it first.} =1 {One of {total} actions happens without asking you. The rest wait for your approval.} other {# of {total} actions happen without asking you. The rest wait for your approval.}}

uniform.allDefault: Nothing here has been customised — every action is on the setting GOTCHA shipped with.
uniform.noEditing: Nobody can change an action's details before approving it. You approve it as proposed, or you don't.
uniform.expiry: An approval request expires after {minutes} minutes. After that it can't be approved, and nothing tells the customer.
uniform.noApprover: No particular person is named as the approver — any admin can approve anything.
